channel.title: CERT@VDE — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by CERT@VDE (certvde).

item.title: CVE-2026-27565 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Remote code execution via uploading a malicious IODD file
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can upload a malicious IODD file that places and executes a shell script with root privileges. The shell script remains active even after a reboot.

item.title: CVE-2026-27564 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via PUT in /api/datastorage/data
item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/datastorage/data endpoint by sending a PUT request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27563 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via GET in /api/datastorage/data
item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/datastorage/data endpoint by sending a crafted GET request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27562 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via PUT in /api/iodd/config
item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/iodd/config endpoint by sending a crafted PUT request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27561 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via GET in /api/iodd/config
item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/iodd/config endpoint by sending a crafted GET request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27560 · 7.2 HIGH — Command Injection via DELETE in /api/status/data
item.description: A high-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/status/data endpoint by sending a crafted DELETE request with admin credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27559 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection via GET in /api/status/data
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /api/status/data endpoint by sending a crafted GET request with user credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27557 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Path Traversal in /index.php/view_uploaded_iodd_file
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a path traversal vulnerability in the /index.php/view_uploaded_iodd_file endpoint allowing the SSH server's private keys to be read.

item.title: CVE-2026-27556 · 8.8 HIGH — Local File Inclusion in /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a local file inclusion vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters endpoint using a valid operator cookie allowing execution of arbitrary PHP code on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27555 · 8.8 HIGH — Local File Inclusion in /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_port_info
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a local file inclusion vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_port_info endpoint using a valid user cookie allowing execution of arbitrary PHP code on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27554 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/save_iodd_parameters endpoint using operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27553 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Information Disclosure via Schema Path Manipulation
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can manipulate the schema path parameter in the /index.php/diagnostics_tab/ajax_diag_table_rows endpoint using a valid user cookie allowing disclosure of all user password hashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-27552 · 8.1 HIGH — Unauthorized IODD File Upload due to Improper Authorization
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit improper authorization in the /index.php/attached_devices_tab/do_upload endpoint to upload IODD files to the device, potentially altering device behavior or causing system crashes.

item.title: CVE-2026-27551 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/ajax/parameterManage
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/parameterManage endpoint using user credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27550 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in Field_Shadow_Password Class
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the Field_Shadow_Password class using operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27548 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_port_info
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_port_info endpoint using user or operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27547 · 8.8 HIGH — Command Injection in /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_menu_info
item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can exploit a command injection vulnerability in the /index.php/ajax/get_iodd_menu_info endpoint using valid user or operator credentials allowing execution of commands with root privileges on the device.

item.title: CVE-2026-27546 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Authentication Bypass in _account_log
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit an authentication bypass in the _account_log function to log in as an admin, even when accounts are properly configured.

item.title: CVE-2026-81625 · 8.8 HIGH — Stack buffer overflow in Greenbone OS and openvas-scanner
item.description: A remote attacker with user privileges may use a malicious or compromised NASL vulnerability test (VT) on the affected products to trigger a stack buffer overflow and gain full access on the compromised system.

item.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can enumerate all configured users and identify which accounts hold elevated privileges using the endpoint /api/user/fetch-all.php.

item.description: An low privileged remote attacker can cause authenticated users to perform unintended actions in the FDS Web interface using malicious web pages.

item.description: A low privileged remote attacker can hijack an active administrative session without needing to know the administrator password by extracting live plaintext session identifiers for authenticated users from downloadable error log archives.

item.description: A high privileged remote attacker can upload a .php file and then request it directly from /uploads/<filename>.php to achieve arbitrary code execution due to improper file type validation which could result in full system compromise.

item.title: CVE-2025-41770 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — Unauthenticated Denial of Service
item.description: An unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability in the device's PLCnext Engineer communication interface allow an remote attacker to interrupt access via the client application. Successful exploitation prevents communication until the PLCnext serv…

item.title: CVE-2025-41769 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Unauthenticated Buffer Overflow in PROFINET Service
item.description: The device's PROFINET service is affected by a buffer overflow vulnerability that exists in the default configuration. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to reboot the device or execute arbitrary code.

item.description: A vulnerability in the iDTM FDI allows an attacker with elevated privileges and access to the host system to enable the debug interface by placing a crafted file in the application directory, potentially resulting in unauthorized access to connected…

item.description: Due to improper neutralization of special elements, an unauthenticated remote attacker is able to inject a command into the system configuration which is subsequently executed as root.

item.title: CVE-2026-44108 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Firewall bypass during shutdown
item.description: Due to a flaw in the execution order of scripts during shutdown, the firewall is terminated prematurely during system shutdown. This creates a temporary window in which internal services may become externally accessible, potentially allowing an unaut…

item.title: CVE-2026-44105 · 6.6 MEDIUM — Cleartext password in logs
item.description: The credentials for the local user "user-app" may be exposed in log files, potentially enabling a low-privileged local attacker with access to the logs to authenticate via SSH as the limited user "user-app". Charging could be interrupted.

item.title: CVE-2026-44106 · 8.5 HIGH — Local Privilege Escalation vulnerability in /etc/init.d/user-applications via customer website file
item.description: A privilege escalation vulnerability in the init-script for user-applications allows a low-privileged local user to execute arbitrary commands as root, resulting in full system compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-44103 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — JupiCore does not perform validation of firmware
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can inject malicious firmware into the internal charging module because the JupiCore service transmits firmware updates without performing integrity or verification check. Successful exploitation may compromise the…

item.title: CVE-2026-44102 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — OCPP Firmware download is not properly locked
item.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger a firmware update download via the OCPP backend by supplying an invalid firmware file. This will cause the file to remain accessible for a short period before it is deleted due to improper locking during…

item.title: CVE-2026-44101 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — OCPP reconfiguration vulnerability
item.description: Due to missing authentication the CHARX OCPP Agent service allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to reconfigure the backend connection. This can lead to Denial-of-Service and confidential data being disclosed to the attacker.

item.title: CVE-2026-44100 · 9.4 CRITICAL 🌩️ — JupiCore charging point reconfiguration without auth
item.description: The CHARX JupiCore service allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to reconfigure charging points. This can lead to disclosure of charging point UIDs, Denial-of-Service and files tampering.

item.title: CVE-2026-44099 · 8.5 HIGH — Local Privilege Escalation via pppd password injection
item.description: A privilege escalation vulnerability in the system configuration allows a low-privileged local user to execute arbitrary commands as root, resulting in full system compromise.
